issues.description: The problem statement and template expect a no-argument assembleBookstore() function, but the solution defines assembleBookstore(count: Int) (a different parameter list) while main() calls assembleBookstore() with no arguments. This parameter mismatch between the intended API and the solution will confuse students and will cause a compilation error or unclear guidance about the correct signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the assembleBookstore API consistent: either change the solution's implementation to match the no-argument signature required by the problem and template (private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore) and remove the unused parameter, or update the problem statement and template to require assembleBookstore(count: Int) (and update calls accordingly). The simplest fix is to remove the count parameter from the solution's assembleBookstore signature so main() can call assembleBookstore() without error.
